context.roleEssence: This role builds and operates the backend systems underpinning Veridian's AI Platform - the retrieval, indexing, and agent infrastructure that Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, and Department Agents all run on. Work is deeply dependent on the reliability, security, and scalability standards Engineering holds itself to, and on tight collaboration with the immediate AI Platform team and cross-functional partners building on top of these services. At IC4/Senior, expertise means owning complex workstreams independently, making sound architectural tradeoffs across GA and Beta surfaces (Beta agents in particular demand extra judgment), and mentoring others - not just executing tickets.

items.shortLine: Meet Shira, walk through your plan
items.detailText: Sit down with Shira Barnea, your manager, to meet properly and walk through what the next eight weeks actually look like.
Get to know the twelve engineers you'll be building alongside day to day, so early collaboration and code review feel familiar rather than cold.
A self-paced look at Veridian's vision, values, and its offices in Tel Aviv, London, and Austin.
Slack is set up for you by Day 1. It's how you'll talk day to day with the AI Platform team and cross-functional channels.
Notion is set up for you by Day 1, for reading team documentation, architecture notes, and the company knowledge base.
HiBob is set up for you by Day 1. It holds your employee profile, time off requests, and the org chart.
Your email, calendar, and shared drives are already set up, ready for you before your first day.
Jira access lands Day 2. You'll use it to track your sprint work and the AI Platform team's roadmap execution.
GitHub access lands Day 3, for opening pull requests and reviewing code across AI Platform's services.
Shira will give you the full picture: team goals, key processes, and where documentation and reporting actually live.
A 45-minute training covering the basics of keeping company data and systems secure. Due by Day 7.
A short, 30-minute rundown of Veridian's expectations for conduct at work. Due by Day 7.
A one-time, 60-minute training on how code review actually works here, including the one-reviewer-plus-CI rule before anything merges.

items.shortLine: Product deep dive: Hub, Assistant, Agents, Governance
items.detailText: Your backend work directly powers Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, and Agents, so this goes deeper than a surface tour: how each product area works and what it depends on underneath.
A real map of the systems you'll be extending: how they're built, and which product areas (Assistant, Agents, Governance) rely on them downstream.
Catch up on how the first sprints are landing and flag anything that's blocking early progress.
A self-paced look at who Veridian serves and where the company fits in the market.
A 40-minute training on data privacy fundamentals and GDPR basics. Due by Day 14.
A 90-minute training on writing secure code, required for Engineering. Due by Day 21.

Veridian runs a dedicated Governance product for permissions, audit, and compliance, and security posture is a real departmental measure. Get familiar with the constraints your backend work operates inside.
